name: MULE
def: Autonomous unmanned ground combat vehicle developed by Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control for the United States Army's Future Combat Systems effort.
facts: Later renamed the multi mission unmanned ground vehicle
The last component of the programme was cancelled in July 2011
